meta.source: CORDIS open data: Horizon 2020 and Horizon Europe projects and participants
meta.unit: EU contribution (ecContribution), EUR million, summed over 2014-2026 grants; not a cash-payment statement
meta.contribution_basis: Totals use ecContribution; the participant ledger also retains netEcContribution for comparison.
meta.participation_rows: One row per operator/programme/project/organisation/role/order; a legal entity can have separate participant and linked-third-party rows. No rows are deduplicated by company name alone.
meta.chips_ju: ECSEL (2014-2020), KDT (2021-2023) and Chips JU (2024-) projects
meta.per_operator_only: Grants go to legal entities, not to fabs; never attribute them to one site. Totals include every entity of the group in the grant data, also outside Europe.
